Azir|mid.identity: Magic damage mage who fights through sand soldiers. Arise! (W) summons a soldier that attacks for him when Azir attacks in range, Conquering Sands (Q) sends the soldiers to a location while slowing, Shifting Sands (E) dashes Azir to a soldier with a shield (stopping on the first champion hit), and Emperor's Divide (R) raises a wall of soldiers that knocks enemies back. His passive lets him rebuild a destroyed tower as a Sun Disc.
Azir|mid.playstyle: Sustained-DPS and zone-control mage, very mechanical. Azir scales well and can turn a fight with his ultimate.
Azir|mid.early_game: Farm with your soldiers (W) and poke your opponent when they come to last hit. Keep a soldier in reserve to escape with E. Avoid all-ins against assassins: you're fragile.
Azir|mid.level_1: Arise! (W) first. Farm and poke with your soldier.
Azir|mid.level_2: Conquering Sands (Q). Moves your soldiers and slows: you can poke from farther away.
Azir|mid.level_3: Shifting Sands (E). A dash to a soldier with a shield: your escape. Advanced combo (later): E → Q → R to knock an enemy toward your team.
Azir|mid.level_6: Emperor's Divide: a wall of soldiers that knocks back. Shuffle combo: W behind the target → E to the soldier → Q to go farther → R to send the target toward your team. It takes a lot of practice.
power_spikes: Level 6: ultimate to knock back and protect.
Two items: dominant zone control and DPS.
Late game: one of the strongest teamfight mages.
Azir|mid.lane_plan: Farm with your soldiers, poke safely and keep a soldier to escape. Keep the wave in the middle or near you against assassins. Join objectives when your wave is pushed. Your passive can rebuild a destroyed tower to defend.
Azir|mid.trading: Basic trade: soldier attacks on your opponent. Long trade: Q to slow → soldier attacks. Engage with the shuffle once you've mastered it; give up on it against assassins who burst you (LeBlanc).
threats: Assassins who dive you when you have no soldier left to escape.
mistakes: Using all your soldiers and having no escape left.
Trying the shuffle without having practiced it.
Staying in range of the enemy burst.

matchup_notes.Yasuo: Your soldiers aren't blocked by Wind Wall: keep him at range.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep a soldier to dodge her Charm.
matchup_notes.LeBlanc: She bursts you before you can react: farm under your tower.
matchup_notes.Twisted Fate: He roams: follow him around the map.

Azir|mid.mid_game: Zone control around objectives with your soldiers and ultimate.
Azir|mid.late_game: Area DPS behind your frontline, ultimate to knock back divers or send a carry toward your team.
Azir|mid.behind: Farm and scale: Azir stays strong in the late game.
Azir|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to survive the lane, scale and dominate teamfights with your soldiers and ultimate.
Azir|mid.final_tip: Always keep a soldier in reserve: it's your only escape.
